design:
## Design tests

The cast of builder 0.44.0 and revision 42 were read blind in whole test scenes among other events (`vision/design_tests_v044.md`, six pictures, six readers). Five placed on their first seed, one on its twelfth (it asked for a content face), and one garden swapped its planter for a raker, as the planting placed with the stopped hose on none of 80 seeds:
- **The reading dog,** in two pictures, read as reading in both, the contradiction named: "holding an open newspaper in its front paws and looking at it as if reading. That is the odd or impossible part, because dogs can't read newspapers". Once "possibly wearing glasses".
- **The dog by the door,** its lead yellow and hanging: "holding a yellow lead in its mouth, as if it is asking to go for a walk".
- **The upward water, the stalking cat, the seesaw's call and the spade** read: the water "shoots up into the air in a curved stream", the cat "about to pounce on the bird", the girl "calling to him", "a red spade".
- **The ice cream:** the man in red's scoop was cream by the colour rule, pink being near his shirt's hue, and pale on his pale skin the cone's tip read as "a moustache or chocolate ice cream smeared on his face" in both pictures that drew it. The rule's threshold went from 40 degrees to 20, which gave him pink again.
intro: The forty-first screen read 82 pictures, the set's 21 and 61 probes, with eleven readers and four scorers: 920 of 927 scored items had full marks, and one was misread. 63 of 64 templates pass the gate. `dog_reading` and `dog_wants_walk`, v0.43's two failures, read 1.00 in five pictures each: the dog sitting up in glasses "as if reading", the yellow lead "as if it wants a walk". `ice_cream` falls, with the one misread: the girl in pink walking with an ice cream in profile, "a small pink thing", a sweet or a flower, in three probes. After the screen her scoop, which the props' colour rule had made cream, was put back to pink and the three pictures read again; they did no better, as the cone is too small at her size. The set's contradictions are back to 1.00 from 0.712.
screen:
Across all 82 pictures 920 of 927 scored items had full marks, and one was misread. Of the 7 under full marks:
- three are the ice cream of the girl in pink walking with it in profile, one in each of three probes, the misread a flower or a lollipop;
- one is the thief bird, "about to steal it or just perching", and one the camera, "a camera (or binoculars)";
- one is the lost balloon, "holding the string by its very tip, or has just let go", and one a picture's clouds, not mentioned.

The set's headline is all items 0.991 (0.955 in v0.43), its contradictions 1.00 (0.712), the reading dog reading in all five of its pictures.

**After the screen.** The gate first failed `ice_cream` at 0.885 on three half marks, all the girl in pink's scoop, cream by the colour rule against her pink dress: "something small and white". The scoop left the rule and is pink for everyone, as in v0.43. Only her ice-cream variants changed; the three probes were rebuilt, every record still rebuilds identical, and each was read again by a fresh reader and scorer. They gave two half marks and a misread, "a small pink thing", "a tiny pink dot": the size, not the colour, is what failed.

**What the full marks rest on.** The scorers' notes mark 7 items they credited in full where the free description commits and the unsure section adds another reading (7 in v0.43). Halved, they take no more templates under the gate.

**Remarks were 3.27 a picture, 268 on 82 pictures**, from 2.29 to 3.86 a reader.
redrawn: `dog_reading`, sitting up in glasses, reads 1.00 in five pictures, its glasses named in two and its paper "floating" beside it in two. `dog_wants_walk`, its lead yellow, reads 1.00 in five. `photo` reads 0.90 again, once "a camera (or binoculars)". `goat_grazing`, in the park only, reads 1.00 in four pictures, tethered and "a little unusual" in all four, never a sheep. `cat_stalks_bird` reads 1.00 in three, its ears and whiskers unremarked. `lost_balloon` reads 0.944, one picture read two ways. `water_upward`, `run`, `sandbox` and `seesaw_heavy` read 1.00 in three pictures each. `ice_cream` falls at 0.846, all three marks the girl in pink walking with her ice cream in profile.
gate: Every template was screened in at least three pictures (41 in three, 11 in four, 5 in five, 3 in six, 2 in seven, 1 in nine and 1 in thirteen), and 63 of 64 pass. `ice_cream` falls at 0.846 with the misread, in thirteen pictures, all three marks on the girl in pink. The lowest that pass are `photo` (0.90), `lost_balloon` (0.944) and `bird_steals` (0.967). Per angle (`vision/v044/gate_yaw.json`), all 24 (template, angle) pairs pass. The gate is a filter, and the pilot with people is the test of difficulty.
inspection: Every cell of the set placed under revision 42: tiers 1 to 3 on v0.43's base seeds, but the tier-3 playground, which placed only on a fresh seed list after 13 base seeds failed, as in v0.43; the tier-4 park and playground on v0.43's seeds with the same templates; the street on its forced set, the square wheel in the upward water's place, which revision 42 keeps out of the street; and the garden on the first seed of a new list, after v0.43's seed and 44 more failed. The five isomorphs are new. The probe pass gave `dog_reading`, `dog_wants_walk` and `photo` five pictures each, and the pass stratified by angle filled the rest. Every picture was looked at before the screen. All 82 records rebuild identical to the pixel, and the library passes the validator in full, 351 of 351.
calib: With the reading dog sitting up again and the lost balloon high on its string, 24 fields of the calibration moved by 0.002 or more, most of all `lost_balloon`'s inference (s from -1.05 to -1.20) and `dog_reading`'s contradiction (from -0.57 to -0.51).
